title: Multiple contracts starting together near $10 million
question: How often did one department start two or more contracts with one prime supplier on the same date, each just below $10 million?
finding: 17 department, supplier and start-date combinations each have at least two contracts with ceilings from $9.5 million to under $10 million, covering 37 contract numbers. The lower band contains 363 contracts across 343 combinations in total. The $10 million to under $10.5 million band contains 39 contracts across 39 combinations, of which 0 have at least two contracts.
how: Sum project-team rows by contract number. Match the recorded department, prime supplier and term start exactly. Compare [$9.5m, $10m) with [$10m, $10.5m). Each row links to the source records for every contract in the group.
limits: These are current ledger ceilings and start dates. The original award amount, applicable approval rules and award date can differ. Separate shelters, services and funding streams can share a start date. The two competitively solicited police-vehicle contracts show identical $9.85 million ceilings but together record less than $10 million paid. Billing overlap would require invoice and scope comparisons.
